commits_data.title: mpeg descriptor: fix EN300468 Annex A text fields
commits_data.message:
mpeg descriptor: fix EN300468 Annex A text fields

Some parsers have non implemented work with Annex A text fields. They may
have encoding symbol at start so we should check it.
I added the checkings for 0x40 (Network Name Descriptor), 0x47 (Bouquet
Name Descriptor) and 0x50 (Component Descriptor).
